title: Federated Learning with Energy-Based Structured Probabilistic Inference
abstract: arXiv:2606.30161v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Federated Learning (FL) enables multiple clients to collaboratively train machine learning models without sharing their local data. However, heterogeneity in client data and the presence of unreliable or adversarial updates make effective server aggregation challenging, motivating methods that adapt client contributions according to their reliability and relationships. In this work, we formulate server aggregation in FL as structured probabilistic inference using conditional random fields. We represent clients as nodes in a graph and define unary and pairwise energy potentials. Unary potentials capture individual client properties, while pairwise potentials encode similarities between clients. This formulation treats individual client evidence and pairwise relationships as coupled evidence in a joint inference problem, allowing client reliabilities to be inferred collectively and the resulting estimates to guide aggregation. translated_title: 基于能量的结构化概率推断联邦学习
translated_abstract: 联邦学习使多个客户端能够在不共享本地数据的情况下协同训练机器学习模型。然而，客户端数据的异质性以及不可靠或对抗性更新的存在，使得有效的服务器端聚合变得具有挑战性，这促使人们研究根据客户端的可靠性和相互关系来调整其贡献的方法。在这项工作中，我们将联邦学习中的服务器端聚合形式化为使用条件随机场的结构化概率推断问题。我们将客户端表示为图中的节点，并定义了一元和成对能量势。一元势捕捉单个客户端的属性，而成对势编码客户端之间的相似性。这种形式化将单个客户端的证据和成对关系视为联合推断问题中相互耦合的证据，使得客户端的可靠性可以被集体推断，并且所得的估计结果可以用于指导聚合过程。
tldr: 该论文提出将联邦学习中的服务器端聚合建模为基于条件随机场的结构化概率推断问题，通过一元与成对能量势分别刻画客户端个体属性与客户端间相似性，从而集体推断客户端可靠性并指导聚合。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates server aggregation in federated learning as structured probabilistic inference over a conditional random field, using unary and pairwise energy potentials to jointly infer client reliabilities for guiding aggregation.
